Description.Name: Nobility Line
Description.Details:
Pulling into the Tincalunas system, you once again send Sumire out on the Leopard to scan ahead at the coordinates that were provided by your last stop at New Roland.

You still feel a little wary yet have come to accept these rewards as legitmate. The Spider was painstakingly scanned and scrutinized over by Yang and his crew, more out of curiousity rather than general security.

It is simply a barren world, long since abandoned by its inhabitants centuries ago. The land is not as harsh as one would think after suffering such a catastrophic lunar event, yet here it is. Tiny active volcanos sparsely dotting the land. As with the last approach, the Leopard spots another unnatural flat plateau adjacent to similar large bay doors built into the rock formation. 

Farah accesses the console and the doors slide open without issue.

Yang pats Farah on the back as they stroll inside the bay.

Description.Name: Continue
Description.Details: Yang spots the lonely Assassin and makes his way up the scaffold into the cockpit. Darius asks, "At least this one is a little bit bigger. Did you find anything novel about this one, Yang?" Yang scratches his head, "As far as I can tell, the cockpit is stock so the life-support is still an issue when it overheats. It does have a top-of-the-line Rangefinder!" Sumire chimes in, "Well, I can readily see a lot more weapons on this thing than what's normal." "Doesn't it look a bit bulkier? I think it is sporting much more armour than your standard model." Farah concludes. Yang tapping at the console, "That's is correct. Both the loadout are armour almost double the stock configuration. Upgraded weapons. Hmmm. OK, here's what you asked for XO. This thing has both CASE in the right torso and an AMS system. In the hands of a gutsy pilot, this thing would be a menace." You bow closer to speak into the mic, "By all means, let's grab her and find the next one shall we?" Farah nods, "Already on it. OK, this is a system I've heard of. it's Bonavista." "That's not too far from here. We could hop over to take a look?" ,Sumire pleads. Mulling it over, you reply, "OK, we'll move onto Bonavista the first chance we get. If we take too long, we might be greeted with an empty bay." Yang nods, "Yeah, I'll never forgive you, Commander if that happens. Ha!"
